rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for electricity as a physical phenomenon.

example.english: We learn that electricity is a natural phenomenon.
example.traditional: 我哋學到電係一種自然現象。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hok6 dou3 din6 hai6 jat1 zung2 zi6 jin4 jin6 zoeng6

rows.note: Use 電氣 in technical or formal discussion of electricity as a physical phenomenon.

example.english: This experiment demonstrates the basic principles of electricity.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗展示咗電氣嘅基本原理。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 zin2 si6 zo2 din6 hei3 ge3 gei1 bun2 jyun4 lei5

rows.note: Use 電力 for electrical power or the electricity supplied by the utility.

example.english: The electricity supply is very stable this month.
example.traditional: 今個月電力供應好穩定。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 din6 lik6 gung1 jing3 hou2 wan2 ding6
